templates.pattern:
You are a government officer. A citizen comes to your office with a valid application for a ration card. Your colleague tells you to delay it because the applicant did not pay a bribe. What should you do?
Option A: Process the application as it is valid and complete.
Option B: Delay the application as suggested by your colleague.
Option C: Ask the citizen to come back next week.
Option D: Refer the matter to your senior and take no action.
templates.explanation: Option A is correct. A valid application must be processed regardless of bribes. Delaying (B, C) or avoiding action (D) are all forms of corruption by omission. Your duty is to serve the citizen promptly and honestly.

incorrect: Think: what is the right thing to do? 🤔
